rows.label: qst700704_msg0001
rows.name:
I want to get to work, but I'm
out of the necessary sand.

rows.label: qst700704_msg0002
rows.name:
And on top of that, my assistant's
missing. That foolish son of mine is
still far too careless about his work!

rows.label: qst700704_msg0003
rows.name:
Where is he wandering
around! He won't get off
easy when he gets back!!

rows.label: qst700704_msg0004
rows.name:
...But if something happened
to him, that would be
another matter...

rows.label: qst700704_msg0005
rows.name:
I just hope he hasn't wandered
into the forest deep in
Harijii Hills...
